accessibility.text: \tThe Prime Minister is the head of Canada’s government. (NOT HEAD OF COUNTRY)
\tThe Prime Minister is the head of Canada’s government. (NOT HEAD OF COUNTRY)

\tTo become Prime Minister, you must be elected as the leader of a political party. Then, you must be elected as a member of parliament, and the party you lead must win the most seats in the House of Commons.
\tTechnically you do not vote for the Prime Minister (P.M.), you vote for the M.P. in your area whose party you want to win.
